lines.zh: 我浮着靠近，四颗星在体侧转。
lines.en: I float closer as four stars orbit me.
I cross half the slope in a step.

lines.zh: 我每走一段，地面就暗一格。
lines.en: Every few steps, the ground dims.
I swing my arm and ki curls with it.
I come at you, unhurried and unstoppable.
I crush whatever stands in my way.
I circle inward, closing the gap.
My shadow climbs the wall first.
I come on very quietly.
I stare ahead, my steps never breaking.

lines.zh: 龙爪离地半寸，风跟着走。
lines.en: My claws hover an inch above the ground; the wind follows.

lines.zh: 我一步步走到你正对面。
lines.en: I step right up in front of you.
I hang still while four stars turn.

lines.zh: 我从龙形变回人形，站稳。
lines.en: I return to human form and settle.
I clench a fist, testing my power.
My ki rises from my feet.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，像看一件旧事。
lines.en: I look down at you like an old memory.
I raise a hand and slowly lower it.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地等了很久。
lines.en: I have waited a long time without moving.
My hem flutters in the air current.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口气，气变成白雾。
lines.en: I exhale and the ki turns to white mist.
I neither smile nor frown.

lines.zh: 我站在那儿，像在压着什么。
lines.en: I stand as if holding something down.
I glance up at the sky.

lines.zh: 我的气在身体外结成一层。
lines.en: My ki hardens into a layer outside me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把手指一根根张开。
lines.en: I spread my fingers one by one.
I look at you and there are stars in my eyes.
I tilt my head, without feeling.
I know you are afraid.

lines.zh: 我的气把你的火压小了。
lines.en: My ki shrinks your fire.
I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，像在数你的岁数。
lines.en: I stare as if counting your years.
I slowly lift my chin.
You have no right to stand here.

lines.zh: 我的手指轻轻敲了敲空气。
lines.en: My fingers tap the air.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了你的整张脸。
lines.en: My shadow covers your whole face.
I keep looking, without flinching.
I smile once, then it is gone.
I say something, very quietly.

lines.zh: 我把手掌翻过来给你看。
lines.en: I turn my palm to show you.
There is no anger in my eyes.
The ki you carry is not worth noticing.
I size you up, inch by inch.
I stand straighter than before.
A grunt comes from my throat.
My ki wavers.
I press a hand to the pain.

lines.zh: 我的气暗了一瞬又亮起。
lines.en: My ki dims for an instant, then flares.
I make not a single sound.
The corner of my eye twitches.
I gather my ki again.

lines.zh: 这一击，还不足让我变形。
lines.en: That strike is not enough to make me change.
I glance, and do not reach.
I push it back.
I nudge it aside with my foot.
That will not buy your life.
I shake my head, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了一下就走了。
lines.en: I bend, sniff, and move on.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，从它上面跨过。
lines.en: I step right over it.
I laugh, and not at that.
I would rather have your strength.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我连眼都没眨。
lines.en: You ram me and I do not blink.
My ki bounces you away.

lines.zh: 我把手一抬，你就停住了。
lines.en: I raise a hand and you stop.

lines.zh: 我们的气撞出一声爆响。
lines.en: Our ki bursts against each other.
I hold you half a block away.
My hem sweeps across your face.
I stand; you fall back two steps.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你身上停住。
lines.en: My shadow stops on you.
I watch you get knocked back.
A thin crack splits the ground.

lines.zh: 她的气与我的撞在一起，又合。
lines.en: Her ki meets mine, then merges.
We hang side by side in the air.

lines.zh: 四颗星绕着我们一起转。
lines.en: Four stars circle us together.
We look at each other, saying nothing.

lines.zh: 我抬手，她的手也抬起来。
lines.en: I raise a hand; hers rises too.
We both lower our ki.
Our shadows join into one line.
She nods, and I understand.

lines.zh: 我们把力量借给对方一点。
lines.en: We lend each other a little power.

lines.zh: 我们朝同一个方向迈步。
lines.en: We step the same way.

lines.zh: 我抬手，东西自己浮起来。
lines.en: I raise a hand and it floats up.
I hold it with ki.
I hold it in my palm and study it.
One look and I cast it away.

lines.zh: 我把它收进袍子的内袋。
lines.en: I tuck it into my robe's inner pocket.
I weigh it; it is nothing.
I grab it and the dirt shakes off.

lines.zh: 我让它在掌上转了一圈。
lines.en: I let it turn once on my palm.
I pick it up and walk on.
I crumble it to powder.
My ki floods out.
I have chosen you.
All four stars point at you.
I raise my palm and light gathers.
I have your signature memorized.
After this step there is no retreat.
I sink my weight.
I begin gathering my ki.
All the ki I held back is now used.
Your position is enclosed.
I take one slow step forward.
I stop testing your depth.
My power creaks in my joints.
I press cracks into the ground.
You are surrounded by four stars.

lines.zh: 我一直朝你走，方向没变。
lines.en: I keep walking at you, never deviating.
I deflect what you throw.
I dodge and you hit air.
I count each of your strikes.
I tighten the circle step by step.
You retreat, I follow.

lines.zh: 我的气把远处的路都封了。
lines.en: My ki seals the roads beyond.
I see only you.

lines.zh: 你绕到侧面，我照样对着你。
lines.en: You circle sideways; I stay facing you.
I raise my hand and the light swells.

lines.zh: 你躲到石块后，石头碎了。
lines.en: You hide behind a stone; it shatters.

lines.zh: 我一直没让你离开两格。
lines.en: I never let you get beyond two blocks.
I do not need to be faster.
You wear down; I do not.

lines.zh: 我把手举到你视线高度。
lines.en: I raise my hand to your eye level.
I press a palm into your chest.

lines.zh: 我一掌推出去，你滑了三格。
lines.en: I push a palm out and you slide three blocks.
My knee drives into your gut.
I sweep my arm and ki crashes down.
I grab you and hurl you into stone.

lines.zh: 我打得不重，可你站不住。
lines.en: I hit light, and you cannot stand.
A knife-hand cuts across your neck.
I spin and my elbow lands solid.
You are driven half a block into the ground.

lines.zh: 星屑从我拳缝里漏出来。
lines.en: Stardust leaks through my knuckles.

lines.zh: 我抬手，光在你身边炸开。
lines.en: I raise a hand and light bursts beside you.
You did not block that.
One kick sends you stumbling.
My fist comes wrapped in stardust.
I knock you flat.
I wait for you to rise, then continue.
A hole opens in the clouds.

lines.zh: 四颗星先出现，然后是我。
lines.en: Four stars appear first, then I do.
The air is pressed low.
I walk out of the light, slowly.
The rules of this world have changed.
A low hum comes from far off.
My ki spreads out first.

lines.zh: 许愿的声音一停，我就到了。
lines.en: The wishing stops and I arrive.
You look up and see four star trails.

lines.zh: 我开始存在，天也跟着低。
lines.en: I begin to exist and the sky sinks.

lines.zh: 我站在被清空的地面上。
lines.en: I stand on ground that has been cleared.

lines.zh: 这里的火把一下全灭了。
lines.en: Every torch here goes out at once.
I am here; you should all leave.
My shadow is longer than a man's.
I spread my arms slowly.

lines.zh: 旧世界的回声跟了上来。
lines.en: Echoes of an old world follow me.
I am pulled out of nothing.

lines.zh: 火焰贴着我的气烧，我甩开了。
lines.en: Fire clings to my ki; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来，砸进土里。
lines.en: I crash down from a height into the soil.

lines.zh: 水压住我的气，我沉了一下。
lines.en: Water presses my ki down and I sink.
The blast tears through my ki shell.

lines.zh: 箭插进我胸口，烧焦了一小块。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my chest, scorching a spot.

lines.zh: 那股力量咬住了我的气。
lines.en: That force bites into my ki.
Hunger slows even the stars.

lines.zh: 脚下的世界消失，我坠进去。
lines.en: The world below vanishes and I fall in.
